label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: First TGL Trade
items.text: Boston Common Golf traded for Shane Lowry from The Bay Golf Club, making him the first player ever traded in TGL history and adding a close friend to Rory McIlroy's roster.

items.headline: Hero World Challenge Leaders
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Hideki Matsuyama headline the star-studded field at the 2026 Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas.

items.headline: Charles Schwab Playoffs Update
items.text: The 2026 Charles Schwab Cup Playoffs will be a three-tournament PGA Tour Champions postseason for the top 72 Schwab points earners, featuring a new St. Louis event replacing Richmond's tournament.
